description: Per-million-token prices (USD) for paid calls made by the Radar agent and its tools. Copied from official provider pages on the fetch date. A model that is missing or has a null price is refused by scripts/radar_spend.py.

claude.notes: Standard (global) pricing, Messages API, not Batch, not fast mode, not inference_geo US-only (1.1x). Haiku 5.5 has two tiers split at 100,000 prompt tokens (input plus cache write plus cache read tokens).

vultr.notes: The page states Serverless Inference requests are billed at $0.55 per 1M input tokens and $2.75 per 1M output tokens. It has no embedding-specific line. For qwen3-embedding-4b the ledger charges every token at the higher $2.75 rate, an upper bound from the same page (the same conservative rate the existing embed guard uses). www.vultr.com/pricing returned HTTP 403 to the fetch.

qwen3-embedding-4b.basis: upper bound: published output rate applied to input tokens, no embedding price published
